podcast.body: Performed on Soul Train in November 1975, this track was the first single from Bowie's next album, 'Station to Station', and continued his funk-infused sound. It became a number 10 hit in early 1976 and anchored the 'Station to Station' album, which marked an "Imperial Peak" for Bowie in the 70s. "While on Soul Train, Boey took the opportunity to perform the first single from his next album, a track that kept the funk going called Golden Years."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
